parsed.missing_from_rule: The rule omits the alternative that the beneficiary may qualify if they use a Medicare-covered continuous subcutaneous insulin infusion (CSII) pump (csii_pump_medicare_covered), not just multiple daily injections.
parsed.explanation: The policy allows qualification either by having three or more daily insulin injections OR by using a Medicare-covered CSII pump. The rule only checks for three or more daily injections and ignores the CSII pump alternative, which would cause some eligible claims to be denied.
